stem: Based on lines 10 and 11 of the poem “The Tree,” what can the reader infer about the speaker?
instruction: Use The Tree to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: The speaker pays little attention to the nearby environment.

options.label: B
options.text: The speaker has suddenly become mindful of the tree.

options.label: C
options.text: The speaker prefers to sleep when it is completely silent.

options.label: D
options.text: The speaker fears the tree has accidentally been cut down.
